milestones.title: Gradle 9.8.2 Toolchain & Build Verification
milestones.summary: Updated settings.gradle.kts with foojay-resolver-convention 1.0.0. Auto-provisioned Java 25. Verified compilation and testing against Paper 26.3.

milestones.title: Centralized Fail-Closed RadarPolicy & Effective Visibility
milestones.summary: Fixed Bug 1 and Bug 2: Enforced fail-closed authorization, required target team for TEAM visibility, and computed effective visibility (TEAM without team -> PRIVATE).

milestones.title: Immediate Cache Invalidation & Event Pipeline
milestones.summary: Fixed Bug 3 and Bug A: Stored owner's real name instead of 'Owner' in createTeam, and added immediate invalidation and HUD refresh pipeline on commands, quit, join, and world changes.

milestones.title: Stuck Action Bar Resolution, Bearing Math Fix & BossBar Compatibility
milestones.summary: Fixed Bug 4, 5, 6, and Bug D: Corrected Minecraft yaw trigonometry (atan2(-dx, dz)), eliminated stuck 'no authorized teammates' messages, added stateful HUD clearing, and implemented configurable BossBar/ActionBar modes.

milestones.title: Comprehensive Regression Testing & Verification
milestones.summary: Executed 58 unit tests across 5 test suites with 100% pass rate. Verified SHA256 (9979973E0697BABCEEEA4C4AC099E0FD91BA394041744D16CEADCEFA244484EA). Prepared single-file conventional commits.

milestones.title: Live Gameplay Repair, /ally Command, Geyser / Bedrock / Offline-Mode & Auto-Accept
milestones.summary: Fixed /team accept 'Not enough arguments' by auto-accepting single pending invitations; added Geyser Bedrock / Floodgate username-based invitation fallback; added /ally main command with rich help menu to prevent command overwrites; added invited player notification messages; added intuitive /radar private, /radar on, /radar off toggles; sent whitespace clear packets for Bedrock action-bar wiping. Verified 62/62 tests passing. SHA256: 45BA1FDA6B471D6E053A0CA202730A9289A2EE0498ED5B36BB0CDD23D8F48284.

milestones.title: Native Locator Bar Privacy Protection, ProtocolLib Adapter, Solo Controls & Comprehensive Setup Guide
milestones.summary: Implemented dual-layer native locator bar privacy protection: 1) Bukkit Attribute synchronization zeroes WAYPOINT_TRANSMIT_RANGE for private and solo players and WAYPOINT_RECEIVE_RANGE when radar is disabled; 2) Optional ProtocolLib packet adapter (ProtocolLibLocatorAdapter) intercepts TRACKED_WAYPOINT packets to filter per-recipient dots so only teammates see each other on the XP bar; 3) Enhanced solo player location controls with dedicated chat confirmations; 4) Created docs/setup.md complete operational and installation guide. All 68 tests passing. SHA256: 8F7D6C21D82DA6BD13D5FE3A54162200A8E9313C99595193EF0B20826D213D92.

milestones.title: Public Radar Activation, Crystal-Clear /ally Status & Command Usability Overhaul
milestones.summary: Fixed public radar tracking by defaulting public-radar-enabled to true across configuration, providers, and packet filters so solo players setting /ally public can immediately see each other; redesigned /ally status with high-clarity color-coded outputs answering team, visibility, and radar screen state; overhauled command feedback on all toggles; added aliases /ally join, /ally delete, /ally hide; handled solo owner leave auto-disband. All 70 unit and integration tests passing. SHA256: 948C8699CD2B4E778072A35B5A7096F8D9186A29D251FBBD13EBD728108125BF.

milestones.title: Strict Team Privacy Isolation, Outside Tracking Prevention & Duplicate Command Pruning
milestones.summary: Enforced non-negotiable team boundary in RadarPolicy preventing outside solo or enemy team players from tracking teamed players; intercepted /ally public in teams to lock to TEAM ONLY; removed /ally radar and pruned redundant tab completions; verified all unit and privacy tests passing. SHA256: C8C1818BA2C0739DBE5D9ACA0414D95CFCEE1519FC261AFE9B089F9BBC15504F.

milestones.title: Bottom Text HUD Toggle, Customizable Detection Radius & Bedrock Touch Quick Commands
milestones.summary: Added /ally hud [on|off] toggle to hide/show action bar text independently from XP-bar locator dots; added SQLite schema migration 2 for persistent hud_enabled and custom_radius; added /ally radius <meters> (and /ally radius reset) to customize player tracking distance; registered short command /a and /a bedrock touch & controller quick guide; updated ActionBarRadarProvider, BossBarRadarProvider, ProtocolLibLocatorAdapter, and /ally status. All 71 tests passing. SHA256: 407E7EE5C9C0C1D22315AD88C14485EFA2A8A90DA1CCFA012F13EA1B2CA76755.
